purpose: Verified contract for the citizen-facing 'Why?' explanation of approved answer claims.
claim_rule: The Why view explains an existing approved answer component and does not create a new conclusion.
evidence_rule: Supporting evidence is shown only within its verified scope.
property_rule: Material property-specific claims retain verified property matching.
temporal_rule: Historical claims retain target-date and legal-version context.
qualification_rule: Material conditions, exceptions and limitations remain visible.
privacy_rule: Restricted evidence is summarized only at the permitted access level.
source_rule: Official source navigation is shown where available.
verification_boundary: The Why view exposes provenance and legal/evidential context without exposing internal reasoning.
